description:
Customize the visitor badge template in Jolly Lobby Track. Open the badge designer (Badge > Design Badge) and modify the layout. 

Requirements:
1. Set the badge title/header to exactly: 'VISITOR PASS'
2. Ensure the 'Visitor Name' data field is present.
3. Ensure a 'Date' or 'Date/Time' field is present.
4. Add a static text footer at the bottom reading exactly: 'TechVision Industries'
5. Save the badge template.
6. Take a screenshot of your final design and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/badge_template_screenshot.png'.
